verdict.rationale: Conductor's hosted MCP server lets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex and other MCP clients manage cloud workspaces, which gives conversational control of the product. Its agents can also configure the cloud computer, run builds and edit setup scripts without confirming each step. In-app operations such as creating workspaces, switching models and merging are documented only as keyboard or UI actions, so natural-language operation of the app itself is limited to agent chat and external MCP clients. missing for 10: a documented first-party natural-language command layer for operating the Conductor app itself, and hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language workspace management.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Conductor's hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server lets ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, and other MCP clients manage your cloud workspaces.
You can also have an agent configure the computer for you: it can test your repositories, edit setup scripts, and run builds.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds — without asking you to confirm each step.
